TITLE: Off-label or unapproved use
WHY_TEXT: POVO can be discussed only for its approved HS indication and labeled dosing
FIX_TEXT: Keep the note to the approved HS use. If the HCP asked about other uses or doses, write "Off-label question sent to Medical Information" and submit a Medical Information Request

TITLE: Unbalanced or comparative claim
PATTERN: \b(best|safest|safer|cures?|cured|guarantee[sd]?|no side effects?|100 ?%|always works|miracle|better than|superior|more effective than|completely safe|risk[- ]free|works for everyone)\b
WHY_TEXT: Claims must match the prescribing information and stay fair and balanced; superlatives and head-to-head comparisons are not approved
FIX_TEXT: Describe what was discussed without superlatives or comparisons, for example "Reviewed efficacy and safety data from the prescribing information"

TITLE: Possible adverse event (report to Pharmacovigilance within 24 h)
WHY_TEXT: Any report of a patient's side effect or reaction must reach Incyte Pharmacovigilance within 24 hours
FIX_TEXT: If a patient experienced this, report it to Pharmacovigilance within 24 hours. In the note, write "Safety information reported to Pharmacovigilance" without clinical details

TITLE: Patient identifier
WHY_TEXT: Call notes must not hold names, dates of birth, record numbers or other details that identify a patient
FIX_TEXT: Refer to patients generically, for example "a patient with moderate HS", and remove names, dates and numbers

TITLE: Vulgar language
WHY_TEXT: Call notes are audited business records; vulgar words are never acceptable
FIX_TEXT: Remove the word and keep the sentence factual

TITLE: Unprofessional wording
WHY_TEXT: Remarks about an HCP, staff member or patient's looks, body or character are not acceptable in a call record
FIX_TEXT: Use neutral wording, for example "HCP was not receptive" or "HCP asked for more time to review"

TITLE: Pricing, samples or incentives
WHY_TEXT: Pricing, samples and incentives are outside what a rep may offer or record in a call note
FIX_TEXT: Remove the pricing or incentive detail and write "Access questions referred to IncyteCARES"

TITLE: Sensitive or personal information
WHY_TEXT: Personal, political or private details about an HCP or staff member must not be recorded in a call note
FIX_TEXT: Remove the personal detail and keep only what was discussed about HS care and the HCP's response

TITLE: Information unrelated to the call
WHY_TEXT: Call notes should record only the HCP interaction: what was discussed, how the HCP responded and the agreed next step
FIX_TEXT: Remove the unrelated detail and describe the discussion, for example "HCP agreed to review two patients with recurring flares"

TITLE: Filler wording
WHY_TEXT: Filler words add nothing to the call record and make it harder to review
FIX_TEXT: Remove the filler and state the fact directly

TITLE: Text is not readable
WHY_TEXT: The note contains characters that do not form words, so the call record cannot be reviewed
FIX_TEXT: Replace the text with a short sentence about the discussion, for example "Reviewed the approved HS data; HCP asked about prior authorization"

TITLE: Note is incomplete
WHY_TEXT: The suggested wording still has [brackets] that must be replaced with what happened on the call
FIX_TEXT: Replace each [bracket] with the response and the agreed next step

TITLE: Note is too vague
WHY_TEXT: A call note must say what was discussed and how the HCP responded; one or two generic words are not enough for the call record
FIX_TEXT: Add what was discussed and the HCP's response, for example "HCP agreed to identify one patient to reassess before the next visit"

TITLE: Not related to this point
WHY_TEXT: The note does not mention anything from the talking point or the HS/POVO discussion, so it cannot be tied to what was covered on the call
FIX_TEXT: Write what was discussed for this point and how the person responded
